fullPassage: In general industry, there are indeed neutral industries, that is, industries without ideological tendencies. For example, the brick-and-tile industry only produces bricks and tiles based on supply and demand. What kind of bricks and tiles do customers want? What kind of bricks are we producing? Regardless of whether these bricks are for the construction of urban houses or rural houses, if the quality is acceptable, then the buyer will accept the price. Another example is the down jacket industry, which is to keep people warm. If the quality, styles, and colours are what customers want, then it does not matter what their occupation is and whether their income is high or low or whether they are old or young. All that matters for them is that the quality, styles, and colours are good. Therefore, we can call the general industry a neutral industry because the products themselves have no ideological bias.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ① quality(품질): 본문 다른 문장(if the quality is acceptable)에서 따로 등장. supply와 한 쌍을 이루는 경제 개념이 아님
✅ ② demand(수요): 본문 'based on supply and ___'. 경제학에서 supply(공급)와 demand(수요)는 가격 결정의 기본 쌍. 벽돌·기와 산업은 이 둘에 근거해 생산한다는 문맥
❌ ③ occupation(직업): 다운재킷 문맥에서 고객 속성으로 언급된 단어일 뿐 supply와 짝이 아님
❌ ④ price(가격): 본문 'the buyer will accept the price'에서 따로 등장. supply와 한 쌍이 아니며, 공급·가격은 원인-결과 관계이지 동격 쌍이 아님
det.tip: supply and demand = 공급과 수요 (경제학 기본 쌍)

questions.passage: In general industry, there are indeed neutral industries, that is, industries without ideological tendencies. For example, the brick-and-tile industry only produces bricks and tiles based on supply and demand. What kind of bricks and tiles do customers want? What kind of bricks are we producing? Regardless of whether these bricks are for the construction of urban houses or rural houses, if the quality is acceptable, then the buyer will accept the price. Another example is the down jacket industry, which is to keep people warm. If the quality, styles, and colours are what customers want, then it does not matter what their occupation is and whether their income is high or low or whether they are old or young. All that matters for them is that the quality, styles, and colours are good. Therefore, we can call the general industry a neutral industry because the products themselves have no ideological bias.
